comment: kiln.skills (kiln-skills.dll): the game's skill tree. TreeLoad (server 0x96ea80 / client 0xec6be0 on svn 1287369) is the per-world loader of g38_skilltree::SkillTree: once the tree's data pointer (+skills/tree.data) is 0 it asks the resource service for the SkillTreeResource and fills the node map (+0x48), link map (+0xa0), id -> index map (+0xf8), the id list by index (+0x150) and the root list (+0x178). Kiln serves the expanded resource (kiln.assets override) right before the original runs, so the game builds every map itself. LoginCheck (0xe00b0 / 0x2f4110) is player_skilltree's check of a player's UnlockedSkillNodes when its initialized flag is 0 (each join): SkillUiRebuild fails on an id the tree does not know, and a failed check makes the game reset the whole tree (free respec); Kiln strips only the unknown ids first. The other symbols are the game's own skill functions, used for diagnostics (simulate) and the strip. Evidence: docs/re/abilities.md section 4 ("Expanding the skill tree"). Shadow table (nodes past the game's caps: index >= 256 or no level byte left, docs/kiln/services/skills.md): IsUnlocked (0x94c480 / 0xea5230: id -> index -> mask bit; 50 call sites in 23 functions on the server, 53 in 25 on the client, every IsSkillUnlocked native and item-sequence requiredSkill check), NodeSet, Reachable, PointsSpent and Reset (0xb9a00 / 0x2ce370: the respec, also the login reset) are hooked; the client overlay adds the skill-tree screen's per-frame update.
